_comment: Super R-Type (USA): bank $04, the data bank of the game code (DB = $04 from reset) — the whole bank as the cartridge holds it, and an index of the tables the ship, the weapons, the Force and the level manager read (format where the code shows it); bank $06 = the object scripts (S_009FA0); tools/dumpship.py, measured by tools/matchship.mjs.

text_erase_op_table.format: words: handlers of the erase commands 0-7

panel_initial.format: words: the panel line $18CC-$1901 at a level start (S_0088FC)

layer_init_table.format: words: layer init handlers by kind (S_008C35)

layer_move_table.format: words: layer move handlers by kind

layer_draw_table.format: words: layer draw handlers by kind

hit_handler_table_b.format: words: the second handler of the same (S_009D3F, M4)

palette_anim_steps.format: words: the step of a palette animation by its kind (S_00A29D)

direction_table.format: bytes: a direction of 16 from the octant and the ratio (S_00A67E)

sequence_table.format: bytes: S_00A71E hands them out one by one ($1CA8)

difficulty_speeds.format: words by difficulty (+ $10 bit for PRO): $84 of the level

demo_records.format: words: pointers of the demo records ($15D7 picks)

difficulty_panel.format: words: pointers of the 5-word panel texts by difficulty ($18CE)

pause_panel.format: words: the 5-word panel text in pause

ship_flame_tiles_a.format: words: tile numbers of the engine flame by $17F3 >> 8 (S_018855)

ship_flame_tiles_b.format: words: tile numbers of the second flame by $17F7 >> 8

ship_metasprite_table.format: words: metasprite records of the ship and its weapons

cheat_power_up.format: words: the in-game instant power-up presses, 0 ends ($01:952D)

cheat_level_select.format: words: R and nine Ups, 0 ends ($01:9687)

ship_hitbox.format: x0, y0 (words, signed), w, h (bytes) — S_009E39

ship_sprite_attr.format: the attribute word of the ship sprite (S_00984B)

ship_tilt_tiles_a.format: words: the ship tile by tilt $16,X >> 8, $FFFF = none (S_01B148)

ship_tilt_tiles_b.format: words: the second tile by tilt

spark_anim_small.format: words: metasprites of the small hit spark ($01:B863)

spark_anim_medium.format: words: metasprites of the medium hit spark ($01:B86E)

spark_anim_large.format: words: metasprites of the large hit spark ($01:B879)

shot_hit_anim.format: words: the shot hitting the terrain ($01:B50B)

shot_hitbox.format: x0, y0, w, h of the shot (S_009C95)

beam_charge_anim.format: words: the charging beam by $16,X >> 8 ($01:B8F6), two columns by the pass parity

beam_hit_anim.format: words: the beam hitting the terrain ($01:BBF7)

beam_kind_table.format: words: the beam handler by charge ($30,X & $1E0) >> 4 ($01:BAAE)

wave_part_scripts.format: words: the object scripts of the six spiral parts ($01:BCBD)

section_sprite_sets.format: words: pointers to the lists of sprite sets by section ($01:DDAA)

section_slot_masks.format: words: the slot bits a section frees ($01:DD7C)

ship_death_anim.format: words: metasprites of the exploding ship ($01:A994), $16,X >> 8 steps of $40
